name: DJZ NoiseFactory plasma (image-space)
plain: Generates colored images with OpenSimplex: plasma, HSV, turbulence, cellular and others. These are image-space only. To enter sampling they must go through VAE encode, then they act as a start image and not as a Gaussian-like noise.
math: Python per-pixel loops over OpenSimplex with scale, octaves and persistence, three interacting fields for plasma. Seeds from Python random.
label: from code
surprise: comfy-plasma (the plasma pack in section 37) has no source in the library; DazzleNodes' copy directory is empty.
